name: android_click_element_by_id
description: Taps an element directly using its sequential [#ID] from the most recent android_get_semantic_tree output.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.

id.description: Sequential element ID (e.g. 1, 2, 5) from the semantic tree digest.
